hypothesis: Within-root terminal-margin targets over post-action semantic pair features improve disjoint calibration root Top-1 over static order and state-value v2.
single_variable: Learning target changed from state winner classification to within-root action preference; representation and protocol otherwise frozen.
notes: No Top-1 or regret gain. The production action has the same sole semantic delta (inventoryTotal +3) but terminal-margin effects of +76 in development and -10 in calibration, proving the linear absolute post-state representation cannot express the needed context-dependent sign. An earlier all-deterministic collection was discarded after exceeding the 700-command bound; no partial labels were retained.

hypothesis: Expanding predeclared disjoint roots while holding the model fixed will determine whether iteration 1's action-delta conflict is stable.
single_variable: Development and calibration seed count increased from one to four per split; representation, candidate cap, continuation policy, learner and metrics remained fixed.
notes: All 12+12 roots and 64 candidates completed under one ruleset. Every exact calibration action-delta pattern has both positive and negative terminal labels; all tested models preserve static choices. The next experiment must measure label stability across a small continuation-policy population before adding action-context interactions.

hypothesis: A fixed production root has a stable terminal-optimal action under a small paired official-built-in continuation seed population.
single_variable: Continuation sampling increased from one baseline seed stream to three paired seed streams on four frozen production roots; roots, candidates, acting policy, engine and command bound stayed fixed.
notes: Sample zero reproduced all iteration-2 terminal margins. Every root's preferred candidate flipped under another continuation. The three-sample mean retained the baseline sign on these selected roots but is not a convergence claim. Single-continuation terminal regret is unsuitable as a supervised label; next use paired sequential sampling with uncertainty and abstention.

hypothesis: A predeclared paired sequential decision rule will abstain instead of forcing labels from the noisy three-sample production puncture.
single_variable: Replaced naive sample-mean sign with exact paired terminal-rank sign tests at stages 3/7/15 using alpha spending and per-stage Bonferroni correction; outcomes were unchanged.
notes: All roots correctly request seven samples. Terminal rank is primary; noisy cash means are diagnostic only. This establishes fail-closed semantics before additional simulation spend.

hypothesis: Seven paired continuations will select only production roots with stable terminal-rank evidence and defer all others.
single_variable: Available paired samples increased from three to seven by computing only indices 3-6; roots, candidates, policy, estimator and alpha spending remained fixed.
notes: The resume path preserved all prior values and atomically appended four samples per candidate. No root clears alpha 0.02. One mean cash advantage reversed from -215.67 to +10, reinforcing that cash diagnostics cannot force a label.

hypothesis: At the frozen fifteen-sample maximum, only production roots with stable paired terminal-rank evidence receive labels and every other root becomes an explicit abstention.
single_variable: Available paired samples increased from seven to fifteen by computing only indices 7-14; roots, candidates, policy, estimator and alpha spending remained fixed.
notes: All roots exhausted the predeclared maximum without terminal-rank significance. Rank ties occur in 4-10 of 15 pairs per root. These production roots are excluded from supervised labels under continuation population v1; the maximum will not be enlarged post hoc.

hypothesis: The same three-sample paired gate will identify any stable hiring or marketing roots before larger continuation spend.
single_variable: Decision family changed from production to two frozen hiring and two frozen marketing roots; sample count, continuation population, candidates and estimator stayed fixed.
notes: Sample zero and candidate reconstruction match iteration 2. Formal selection is 0/4. Stages 3 and 7 cannot mathematically select among three candidates after Bonferroni correction, so the estimator now reports reachability and skips to 15. Further weak-built-in sampling is deferred until opponent population v1 is defined.

hypothesis: A frozen multi-archetype opponent population can expose reproducible sampling and explicit public-history sensitivity without accepting hidden state.
single_variable: Continuation opponent representation changed from one official-built-in seed stream to a versioned four-archetype population contract; no action-regret labels or search policy changed.
notes: The contract separates observed/derived/believed provenance, binds updates to a public-history digest and updater id, and records model id/confidence/sample count. External policies see legal views only; official AI delegates to the environment adapter. Hand-set priors are explicitly uncalibrated and cannot yet drive rollout labels or search.

hypothesis: Public event-count prefixes identify frozen opponent policies on disjoint official-engine games while rejecting unmodelled human play as OOD.
single_variable: Added a Laplace-smoothed public-event histogram likelihood model over the frozen population; policies, 160-command horizon, six development and six calibration seeds and promotion holdout stayed fixed.
notes: All 12 official-engine prefixes and 48 seat samples passed public-only/balance/split gates. Known-policy Top-1 missed the frozen gate; deterministic and random styles were confused. Human OOD passed, but remaining predictions were overconfident and collapsed toward official built-in. Histogram beliefs stay disconnected; next hold protocol/model fixed and add bounded public temporal/context features.

hypothesis: Adjacent public event transitions improve frozen-policy identification without weakening human OOD detection.
single_variable: Feature representation added adjacent within-seat public event transitions; policies, seeds, seat rotations, 160-command horizon, likelihood model, smoothing, OOD method and gates remained identical to iteration 9.
notes: V2 exactly reproduces v1 unigram counts and adds only public order. Both selection gates pass, but two seeded-random samples are confidently misclassified as safe-first and all 24 samples occupy the highest confidence bin. Promote only to independent temperature/abstention calibration on new validation seeds; live beliefs and search remain disconnected.

hypothesis: A scalar temperature and frozen confidence abstention threshold calibrate temporal opponent beliefs on unseen official-engine seeds.
single_variable: Added scalar temperature and confidence abstention fitted on the consumed calibration split; temporal features, likelihood model, policies, horizon and OOD method stayed fixed, with six new validation seeds.
notes: Temperature calibration generalized and four of five gates passed, but coverage missed by one sample. The global NLL threshold rejected six correctly classified style-specific samples. The validation block is consumed; do not relax the gate. Next fit class-conditional OOD thresholds on old calibration data and evaluate once on fresh seeds.

hypothesis: Predicted-class-conditional NLL thresholds recover valid belief coverage without reducing accepted accuracy.
single_variable: Replaced one global OOD NLL threshold with 95th-percentile thresholds by predicted model fitted on the old calibration rows; temperature, confidence threshold, temporal features, policies, horizon and gates remained frozen, with six new validation seeds.
notes: Class-conditional OOD fixed the prior coverage failure and every accepted prediction was correct, but frozen temperature 3 worsened log loss on the second independent block. Do not select temperature 1 post hoc. Next predeclare block-robust calibration using consumed blocks as development and evaluate once on multiple fresh blocks; beliefs remain disconnected.

hypothesis: Worst-block-constrained calibration generalizes across multiple fresh seed blocks without aggregate masking.
single_variable: Replaced single-block scalar-temperature fitting with a deterministic three-consumed-block worst-case calibration rule; temporal model, predicted-class OOD thresholds, four policies, horizon and per-block gates remained fixed, then 18 fresh games were partitioned into three predeclared blocks.
notes: All three fresh blocks passed independently; aggregate performance was not used to rescue a subgroup. Freeze calibration v5 and advance only to information-set consistency. Belief-driven search and the promotion holdout remain disabled.

hypothesis: A paired-world audit can detect strategy fusion without persisting private simulator state.
single_variable: Added an independent information-set consistency audit primitive; no planner, evaluator, belief calibration or policy behavior changed.
notes: The harness rejects unequal public information sets and illegal candidates, reuses identical belief samples across worlds, and reports ids/counts only. P3.3e remains open until official-engine paired fixtures and the actual belief-aware planner pass.

hypothesis: The current official rollout is invariant to real hidden reserve-card submission envelopes that share one public information set.
single_variable: Replaced synthetic trusted worlds with an official-engine reserve-card simultaneous fixture; planner, evaluator, belief population, candidates and zero-TV gate remained unchanged.
notes: Official legal transitions produced different private move envelopes with identical public state. The sanitized report is byte-reproducible after normalizing display-only history timestamps. P3.3e remains open for another authentic hidden boundary and the belief-aware planner.

hypothesis: The current official rollout is invariant to hidden opponent restructuring submissions that change next-working-day capabilities but share one public information set.
single_variable: Added a second official-engine paired fixture at restructuring; planner, evaluator, belief population, candidates and zero-TV gate remained unchanged.
notes: Corrected the prior working-day-boundary assumption because base working day is sequential. Official restructuring worlds used different active-vs-beach opponent assignments. The first reproduction check exposed wall-clock-sorted display history; a frozen fixture clock made the report byte-reproducible. P3.3e remains open until the actual belief-sampled planner passes.

hypothesis: Explicit switching cost, confidence, hysteresis and cooldown can capture genuine opportunities without plan tunneling or oscillation.
single_variable: Added a deterministic public-evidence plan-health arbiter and connected its selected relation to bounded candidate priority; official legality, evaluator, opponent belief, rollout and promotion holdout remained unchanged.
notes: Genuine expiry deviates temporarily; destructive bait continues; reusable failure repairs; infeasible alternatives pivot or abandon. Tactical deviation preserves the plan graph, and pivot/abandon require explicit replacement. This promotes the control contract only; P4 must calibrate values and prove terminal league lift.

hypothesis: A bounded belief-sampled scenario beam can traverse multiple actor decisions and fresh simultaneous phases while preserving information-set consistency and legal fallback.
single_variable: Added the scenario-beam planner contract and production adapter; frozen evaluator, candidate generator, opponent population, official engine and promotion holdout remained unchanged.
notes: The official smoke crossed restructuring and selected skip over turn-1 hire because the current cutoff evaluator preferred 39 over 35.4. Future simultaneous actor commitments are frozen across matched belief samples to prevent strategy fusion. Proceed to one-/three-second development leagues and horizon sensitivity; do not integrate into live play.

hypothesis: The actual ScenarioBeam production adapter safely returns an information-set-consistent policy on official live simultaneous roots with different trusted hidden submissions.
single_variable: Replaced the previously audited bounded-rollout recommendation with ScenarioBeam v1 on both frozen official paired-world fixtures; engine, static candidates, opponent population, beliefs and zero-TV gate remained unchanged.
notes: ScenarioBeam safely declines live simultaneous roots before cloning and returns the same static public candidate. P3.3e closes for this planner version only; any future hidden-boundary search specialist must pass independently. Playing strength remains unpromoted.

hypothesis: A single ScenarioBeam intervention under declared one-second or three-second budgets can improve terminal play over the same static policy.
single_variable: Allowed exactly one first eligible working-day ScenarioBeam intervention; all subsequent agent decisions, official opponent, two development seeds and paired seats remained common across arms.
notes: One-second Beam safely fell back to hire. Three-second Beam completed and changed hire to skip in every paired game, causing 0/4 wins versus static 4/4. Stop league expansion; diagnose horizon/leaf ranking and add a safety gate before retesting.

hypothesis: The harmful skip choice is an intermediate-horizon alias where hiring cost is visible before delayed engine revenue.
single_variable: Swept only maxOwnDepth from 1 through 8 on the identical official root, candidates, opponent belief and matched sample seeds; deadline and transition caps were non-binding.
notes: Fixed deeper search is not a safe or budget-compliant repair. Next change one variable: a shallow/deep recommendation-agreement gate before any search override.

hypothesis: A shallow/deep agreement gate can prevent intermediate-horizon regressions without changing legal fallback behavior.
single_variable: Added only recommendation agreement before a completed Beam may override static; corrected all arms to common player ids, game ids and official-opponent random streams.
notes: Iteration 20 was confounded because opponent seeds included arm ids. Under corrected common randomness, ungated Beam remains harmful. Agreement restores exact static outcomes but always abstains; one-second latency misses cap. Do not claim strength promotion.

hypothesis: Reserving 20% of each external deadline for non-preemptible official-engine transitions will make both tiers meet wall-clock caps without changing decisions.
single_variable: Reduced the internal cooperative planning envelope to 80% of the external deadline; candidates, evaluator, depths, beliefs, seeds, agreement gate and terminal continuations were unchanged.
notes: Both tiers now meet observed caps and preserve exact controlled terminal outcomes. The gate still abstains on every tested decision; next seek disjoint beneficial accepted changes before any strength claim.

hypothesis: The three-second agreement planner will complete and accept at least one non-static change on disjoint development decisions.
single_variable: Scanned up to six eligible decisions on each of four fresh trajectories; policy, depth, headroom, evaluator, beliefs and candidates remained frozen.
notes: All decisions failed closed because depth 4 could not complete inside the 2.4-second internal envelope. Next test target depth 3; the known harmful root remains protected because depth 1 and depth 3 disagree.

hypothesis: Reducing only target actor depth from 4 to 3 will make the agreement gate live and accept terminally auditable changes while still blocking the known bad skip.
single_variable: Changed maxOwnDepth 4→3 on the identical 24 roots; shallow probe, headroom, evaluator, beliefs, candidates and seeds remained fixed.
notes: All seven completed agreements repeated static; the four non-static deep choices were known harmful skips and disagreed with shallow. Expand later/fresher development roots before altering the gate.

hypothesis: Later decisions and fresh trajectories will expose non-static shallow/deep agreements that can be terminally audited.
single_variable: Expanded each fresh trajectory from six to twelve eligible decisions while retaining depth 3, headroom, candidates, evaluator, beliefs and exact agreement gate.
notes: Even through turn 4, every completed agreement repeats static. Retain agreement only as a safety diagnostic and move to equal-budget RHEA rather than tuning correlated thresholds.

hypothesis: A deterministic RHEA can optimize bounded public macro sequences through official clones under the same candidates, beliefs and leaf evaluator as Beam.
single_variable: Added the RHEA optimizer and official adapter; candidate generator, opponent population, belief samples, evaluator, engine and promotion holdout stayed frozen.
notes: RHEA is executable and reproducible but selects the same known harmful skip. Optimizer substitution does not repair the shared cutoff evaluator. Next information-set and equal-budget audits.

hypothesis: The actual RHEA adapter safely returns one information-set-consistent policy on official live simultaneous roots with different trusted hidden submissions.
single_variable: Reused the two frozen official paired-world fixtures with RHEA v1 in place of ScenarioBeam; beliefs, candidates, engine and zero-TV gate stayed fixed.
notes: RHEA safely declines live hidden roots before cloning. Information safety passes; latency and terminal strength remain unpromoted.

hypothesis: The minimum official-engine RHEA can complete a common-sample comparison of both root actions within both one- and three-second external budgets.
single_variable: Changed only the external deadline between 1000ms and 3000ms on the same frozen root, candidates, belief, samples, population-two, one-generation and horizon-two configuration; repeated timing eight times per tier.
notes: The one-second tier is at the latency boundary, while the three-second tier is underused. Next enable a second generation only for the three-second arm; do not infer playing strength from this single root.

hypothesis: The unused three-second capacity can support a genuinely exploratory second RHEA generation with all other planner inputs frozen.
single_variable: Changed generations 1→2 in the three-second arm and raised only the evaluation ceiling required to admit it; root, population, horizon, candidates, belief samples, evaluator and evolution seed stayed frozen.
notes: Every run reported two generations but the second population was entirely cached. Add a novelty-preserving mutation contract before repeating the same fixture; the apparent latency margin is not evidence of useful search.

hypothesis: Novelty-preserving one-gene mutation will turn the cached second generation into real exploration while remaining inside the three-second external budget.
single_variable: Changed only mutation collision handling: seeded one-gene alternatives now exclude both the next population and evaluation cache; the iteration-30 root, candidates, belief, samples, population, horizon, generations, evaluator and seed remained frozen.
notes: The repaired optimizer performs genuine second-generation work with ample three-second margin and preserves the correct static root. Freeze this mutation rule and move to disjoint multi-root paired terminal comparison.

hypothesis: At equal three-second compute, novelty-preserving RHEA is more terminally robust than the harmful Beam override and may improve on static across fresh paired games.
single_variable: Changed only the decision arm among static, Beam and RHEA on two fresh seeds × both seats; each planner could alter one eligible root, with common belief samples, common opponent random streams and identical static continuation thereafter.
notes: RHEA exactly preserves static terminal outcomes while Beam repeats the harmful skip on all roots. RHEA remains unpromoted because it never changes static; next scan later heterogeneous roots and terminally audit every non-static intervention.

hypothesis: Later heterogeneous development decisions will expose non-static three-second RHEA choices that can be audited to terminal outcomes.
single_variable: Expanded observation from the first eligible root to eight eligible roots per trajectory on two fresh seeds × both seats; optimizer, two-root allocation, beliefs, samples, evaluator and continuation policy remained frozen.
notes: Every two-root set contained the static action plus fallback/skip, excluding meaningful same-intent alternatives before search. Next widen roots 2→3 with a one-generation breadth audit; do not tune the evaluator from this evidence.

hypothesis: A third breadth-first root will expose meaningful same-intent alternatives and reveal whether their leaf-value advantages translate to terminal improvement.
single_variable: Changed root allocation 2→3 on the identical 32 public roots, using population three and one generation solely to evaluate every root under the same two belief samples; evaluator, opponent policy, main trajectory and terminal continuation remained frozen.
notes: Breadth exposes alternatives, but the shared ~+1.4 leaf margin cannot distinguish four wins from four losses. Freeze contradictory roots and collect paired multi-continuation stability estimates; do not promote, deepen, or train from single-continuation labels.

hypothesis: Opposite single-continuation labels for the same hire override will remain stable under matched opponent continuations if root context truly determines its value.
single_variable: Expanded only two frozen contradictory hire roots from one to three matched continuations per candidate; candidates, root reconstruction, continuation policy, primary rank objective and sequential protocol stayed frozen.
notes: The previously beneficial root was only a same-rank cash gain and the alternate loses rank on an added continuation. Preserve the verified three-sample prefix and append samples 3–6 only; do not train yet.

hypothesis: Appending four matched continuations will determine whether the apparent static hire advantage becomes selectable while preserving the verified three-sample prefix.
single_variable: Added only samples 3–6 for the same two roots and candidates; all prior arrays, continuation policy, sequential alpha schedule and primary rank objective remained frozen.
notes: Both roots favor static directionally but remain far from the declared significance threshold. Resume samples 7–14 only with strategic-projection and prefix checks; make no interim policy change.

hypothesis: The directional static hire advantage will reach the predeclared maximum-stage selection threshold when eight more matched continuations are appended.
single_variable: Added only samples 7–14 for the same roots and candidates; the seven-sample prefix, strategic projections, continuation policy, alpha schedule and primary rank objective remained frozen.
notes: Static never loses rank but too many ties prevent formal selection at the fixed maximum. Stop sampling and exclude these roots from supervision; keep static online and move the bounded stability puncture to training overrides.

hypothesis: The apparently stronger training override will retain terminal-rank or consistent secondary cash advantage across matched continuations despite contradictory single-sample labels.
single_variable: Expanded only two frozen contradictory training roots from one to three matched continuations per candidate; roots, candidates, continuation policy, primary rank objective and sequential protocol stayed frozen.
notes: The old own-cash harmful label is invalid: the alternate never loses rank and has higher cash on every tied sample. Preserve the three-sample prefix and append samples 3–6 only; no online policy change yet.

hypothesis: Four added continuations will make the training alternate selectable at seven samples if its early rank/cash advantage is stable.
single_variable: Added only samples 3–6 for the same two roots and candidates; the three-sample prefix, strategic projections, continuation policy, alpha schedule and rank-primary objective stayed frozen.
notes: Training remains directionally stronger than hire, but neither root meets the declared threshold. Resume samples 7–14 only and do not generalize a training-phase gate.

hypothesis: The training alternate will reach maximum-stage selection on at least one frozen root while preserving the seven-sample prefix.
single_variable: Added only samples 7–14 for the same roots and candidates; the seven-sample prefix, strategic projections, continuation policy, alpha schedule and rank-primary objective stayed frozen.
notes: One training root selects the alternate and one only gains cash at equal rank. Compare public root context, predeclare one bounded interaction, and validate on independent roots before any online override.

hypothesis: A public market-position interaction distinguishes the root where CEO-to-Management-Trainee changes terminal rank from the candidate-matched root where it improves only cash.

hypothesis: The preregistered severe-market-disadvantage interaction will identify an independent root where CEO-to-Management-Trainee has terminal-rank advantage while abstaining on an unmatched root.
single_variable: Evaluated the exact frozen interaction on two untouched seat-1 roots with three paired continuations; discovery roots, candidates, continuation policy, estimator and holdout stayed frozen.
notes: The matched root is directionally strong, but the deficit-7 unmatched root also favors the alternate once. Preserve all prefixes and continue both to seven; if unmatched also selects, reject rather than retune the threshold.

hypothesis: Four added paired continuations will distinguish the preregistered matched root from its near-boundary unmatched control without changing the interaction.
single_variable: Added only samples 3–6 for both independent roots; all prefixes, candidates, public features, strategic projections, estimator and threshold stayed frozen.
notes: The unmatched root is directionally stronger than the matched root, so final falsification is plausible. Continue both to 15 without threshold edits. Demote the volatile whole-view digest and use normalized projection+features+candidate identity going forward.

hypothesis: At 15 samples the preregistered severe-market-disadvantage interaction will select the matched root while the unmatched root abstains.
single_variable: Added only samples 7–14 for both independent roots and introduced a normalized root identity digest; prefixes, candidates, public features, strategic projections, estimator and interaction remained frozen.
notes: The matched root did not select, so reject and do not retune the map threshold. Across four known roots the alternate has 21 rank wins vs one static win in 60 continuations, but samples are clustered and discovery-contaminated. Next preregister an exact action-pair hypothesis and validate on untouched roots.

single_variable: Scanned four new seeds across both seats under the static trajectory and captured only the first exact candidate-pair root; no alternate terminal branch was executed or persisted.
notes: All roots are frozen before outcomes. At 15 paired continuations, use roots as units and require >=7 decisive, >=7 alternate-positive, 0 static-positive, exact two-sided root-sign p<=0.025. Passing only admits a paired league; it does not deploy online.

hypothesis: The candidate-wide alternate will show non-negative root-level rank direction at the three-sample integrity checkpoint across all eight frozen roots.
single_variable: Collected exactly samples 0–2 for both candidates on every frozen root; roots, candidate actions, continuation policy, normalized identities and the 15-sample root gate stayed fixed.
notes: The root-level audit cannot pass before 15 samples. Preserve all samples, including within-root reversals, and append samples 3–6 for all eight roots without filtering.

hypothesis: Four added continuations will stabilize the candidate-wide direction while preserving all eight frozen roots and three-sample prefixes.
single_variable: Added only samples 3–6 for both candidates on every root; root set, prefix, candidate actions, continuation policy, identities and final root gate stayed frozen.
notes: One root is static-positive by only one net rank outcome over seven and can still reverse in the eight remaining samples. Preserve all roots and append samples 7–14 before applying the candidate-wide gate.

hypothesis: At 15 samples the exact action-pair alternate will satisfy the preregistered root-level generalization gate across eight untouched roots.
single_variable: Added only samples 7–14 for every frozen root using four process-isolated collection shards, then strictly merged exact target coverage; roots, prefixes, candidates, streams and gate stayed frozen.
notes: The rule misses >=7 alternate-positive, zero static-positive and p<=0.025. Keep static online. The 12-root development evidence now suggests exclusiveHouses<=1 as a one-feature classifier; preregister and validate it only on another untouched set.

hypothesis: A preregistered one-feature classifier using exclusivelyReachableHouses<=1 can be frozen on a balanced untouched root set before terminal outcomes.

notes: At 15 samples matched roots require >=7 decisive, >=7 alternate-positive, zero static-positive and p<=0.025; unmatched roots permit zero alternate-positive. Feature, threshold, roots and membership are immutable.

hypothesis: Three paired continuations will verify exact reconstruction and prefix integrity for all frozen classifier roots without producing an eligible classifier verdict.
single_variable: Collected samples 0-2 for both candidates at every frozen root in four process-isolated shards; classifier, membership, roots, candidates, continuation policy and final gates stayed frozen.
notes: The unmatched alternate-positive root is retained as preregistered evidence, not removed or used to retune the threshold. Append samples 3-6 for all roots before the next integrity checkpoint.

hypothesis: Four added paired continuations will preserve all frozen roots and three-sample prefixes while measuring classifier direction at the seven-sample integrity stage.
single_variable: Added only samples 3-6 for both candidates at every root in four process-isolated shards; classifier, membership, roots, candidates, streams and final gates stayed frozen.
notes: No preregistered futility rule exists and the positive unmatched means can still reverse in eight samples. Preserve all roots and append samples 7-14 before applying both gates once.

hypothesis: At 15 samples the frozen exclusivelyReachableHouses<=1 classifier will satisfy both its matched benefit gate and unmatched safety gate.
single_variable: Added only samples 7-14 for both candidates at every frozen root in four process-isolated shards; roots, prefixes, candidates, memberships, streams and both gates stayed frozen.
notes: Keep static online. Do not retune a cutoff on these validation roots. The post-hoc 9 alternate-positive / 0 static-positive / 3 tied aggregate cannot reopen the earlier rejected unconditional hypothesis or the sealed holdout.

hypothesis: The dominant single-marketing proposal loss is bounded spatial-effect selection rather than duration omission or legality decoding.
single_variable: Added an audit-only exhaustive public single-marketing effect enumerator and loss counters; production candidate generation and the sealed games 51-100 validation slice were unchanged.

hypothesis: Three effect-distinct spatial representatives will improve marketing proposal coverage on an independent slice without increasing the candidate cap or violating official legality.
